analysis: Examined docs-only changes. cli-reference.md head 1289-1888 is mostly unchanged context; changed head ranges in this batch are 1885 (Autopilot selected_models: with saved consent the running provider adds every verified downloaded catalog build to the Autopilot set). quickstart.md head 65-71 and 109-116 document new Autopilot behavior: once enrolled, downloaded verified catalog builds join the Autopilot set at next start without a new consent step, and Autopilot may download catalog models on the operator's behalf (bounded by `autopilot downloads enable --max-storage-gb/--max-models`, disable switch, never deletes). These describe operator-local residency/disk-usage behavior; the operator is the consenting party (enrollment is explicit, default No) and downloads are limited to verified catalog builds, so A-004/T-012/T-027 weight integrity (verified-weights, catalog hashes) is not shown weakened. Disk consumption relates to T-016 availability, but limits and disable control are documented; the default limits when enabled are not visible here. No change to cache (T-041), attestation (TB-009/TB-011), tokens (A-008), or LaunchAgent passthrough lists. Integration should check, in the source batches, that Autopilot downloads verify catalog hashes before use, that download storage limits interact safely with the SSD prefix-cache 20 GiB free-space reserve and model admission, whether downloads are on by default after enrollment (docs imply 'may download' without explicit enable), and that newly joined models still require consent-scoped verification (the waiting_inventory change at head 14-16 lets update prefetch add models to the set). No code evidence supplied, so no regression is established.
